In many Islamic cultures, the naming of a child is given careful thought and consideration, reflecting the family's hopes and dreams for the child's future. data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic traditions, the naming of a child is not only a matter of cultural significance, but also a spiritual one. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Give names to your children that are the names of righteous people." (Bukhari and Muslim). The name Gileem, meaning Beautiful, can be seen as a reminder of the inner beauty that every individual possesses and striving to develop, in accordance with the teachings of Islam. The name also reflects the belief that the true beauty of a person lies in their good character and actions, rather than just their physical appearance. Additionally, the name can inspire the person to strive towards being a source of beauty and joy in the lives of others.
